pages.title: Comedy Shows in Houston Tonight
pages.meta_description: Every stand-up comedy show in Houston tonight, {today} — headliners, showcases and open mics across every club, with showtimes, prices and direct ticket links. Updated twice daily.
pages.intro_html: Looking for comedy shows in Houston tonight? This list covers every stand-up show happening across the city — touring headliners at the Improv and Punch Line, showcases at The Secret Group and The Riot, speakeasy shows at The Den, and the free open mics where Houston's next headliners are working out new material. We update this page twice a day with showtimes, prices, and direct ticket links, so what you see is what's actually still on sale. Most weeknight shows start between 7:30 and 8:00, and the late shows kick off after 10 if your night's just getting started.

pages.meta_description: Every comedy show in Houston this weekend ({weekend_range}) in one place — Friday, Saturday and Sunday shows at every club, with prices, showtimes and ticket links. Updated twice daily.
pages.intro_html: Every comedy show happening in Houston this weekend, all in one place. Friday and Saturday nights are when the big touring names roll through the Improv and Punch Line, but the weekend runs deeper than that — late-night showcases, uncensored after-hours shows, Sunday night lineups, and free rooms that don't cost you anything but the drink in your hand. We pull listings from every club and independent room in the city and update twice daily, so you can compare showtimes and prices without opening six different websites. Planning a date night or a group outing? Grab tickets early — weekend headliner shows in Houston sell out more often than you'd think.

pages.title: Free Comedy Shows in Houston
pages.meta_title: Free Comedy Shows in Houston | Comedy Houston
pages.meta_description: Every free comedy show in Houston — weekly showcases, bar shows, and open mics that cost nothing to attend. Updated twice daily with times and locations.
pages.intro_html: Houston has one of the best free comedy scenes in the country — you just have to know where to look. Every week there are free shows and open mics across the city: bar showcases where working comics sharpen their best material, and open mics where you might catch a future headliner's first great set. Free doesn't mean an afterthought, either; several of these rooms are run by the same comics and producers behind the ticketed shows downtown. This page tracks every free comedy show in Houston, updated twice daily. Most are 21+, most want you to buy a drink, and all of them want you in a seat laughing.

pages.title: Comedy Open Mics in Houston
pages.meta_title: Comedy Open Mics in Houston — Full Weekly List | Comedy Houston
pages.meta_description: The complete list of comedy open mics in Houston, updated twice daily — where to watch, where to perform, and when sign-up starts, every night of the week.
pages.intro_html: This is the complete, current list of comedy open mics in Houston — whether you want to watch comedy in its rawest form or get on stage yourself. The city runs mics nearly every night of the week, from long-running rooms at The Secret Group to bar mics scattered across town, and each one has its own personality, sign-up rules, and crowd. If you're a new comic, open mics are where you start: show up early, get your name on the list, and keep your set tight. If you're an audience member, admission is free and the comedy is unpredictable in the best way. We update this list twice daily so you never trek across town to a mic that moved or died.

pages.title: Black Comedy Shows in Houston
pages.meta_title: Black Comedy Shows in Houston | Best Shows & Where to Go
pages.h1: Black Comedy Shows in Houston: Where to Go This Week
pages.meta_description: The best Black comedy shows in Houston — For the Culture at The Secret Group, plus national headliners at Punch Line and the Improv. Real shows, real dates, updated twice daily.
pages.intro_html:
Houston has one of the strongest Black comedy scenes in the country — it just doesn't have one place that tells you where to find it. This page fixes that. We track every show in the city, twice a day, and hand-pick the ones worth your night out.

Start with For the Culture

Every Tuesday at The Secret Group in EaDo, For the Culture is exactly what the name promises: a weekly showcase built by and for Black Houston comedy. It's the room where the city's funniest working comics sharpen material, and at a Tuesday-night price it's the best value in town. If you only try one show on this page, make it this one.

Punch Line is the headliner house

No club in Houston books more national Black headliners than Punch Line — the kind of lineups you'd expect in Atlanta or Chicago, playing a 300-seat room off 610.

The Improv brings the big names down to club size

Arena-level comics play the Houston Improv's Katy Freeway room all year — seeing a comic with that résumé from thirty feet away beats any theater balcony. These sell out; don't wait on tickets.

When to go

Tuesday for For the Culture, Friday and Saturday for headliners. Most club shows run about 90 minutes with a two-item minimum; EaDo shows are cheaper and looser. Every listing below links straight to the box office — no resellers, no markup — and this page updates twice a day as lineups change.

Know a Black comedy show we should be listing? Tell us about it.

pages.title: Spanish Comedy Houston — Comedia en Español
pages.meta_title: Spanish Comedy Houston | Comedia en Español — Every Show
pages.h1: Comedy en Español in Houston: Every Spanish-Language Show
pages.meta_description: Every Spanish-language comedy show in Houston — comedia en español at the Improv, Punch Line, and Den Comedy Club, with dates, prices, and direct tickets. Updated twice daily.
pages.intro_html:
Houston is nearly half Hispanic, and the city's Spanish-language comedy scene has outgrown the occasional one-off — there are now shows en español at the Improv, Punch Line, and the Den Comedy Club almost every month. This page tracks all of them in one place, updated twice a day.

Comedia en español, toda en un solo lugar

Aquí encuentras cada show de stand-up en español en Houston: giras nacionales en el Houston Improv, comediantes de México y Latinoamérica en Punch Line, y shows íntimos en The Den Comedy Club. Precios, horarios y boletos directos — sin revendedores.

What plays here

Touring headliners from Mexico and across Latin America come through Houston constantly — recent runs include Iván Fematt «La Mole», Richie O'Farrill, and the Standoperos collective — alongside local Spanish-language showcases and bilingual comics working both rooms. Some shows are fully en español; others are bilingual. Check the listing description before you buy if that matters for your group.

When to go

Spanish-language shows cluster on weekends at the bigger clubs, with intimate weeknight dates at the Den. They sell out faster than English-language shows — smaller rooms, loyal audiences — so book early. Every listing below links straight to the box office, and the list refreshes twice a day as new dates are announced.

¿Conoces un show en español que nos falta? Escríbenos.

pages.title: Clean Comedy Shows in Houston
pages.meta_title: Clean Comedy Shows in Houston | {month_year} Guide
pages.h1: Clean Comedy Shows in Houston, Verified and Updated Daily
pages.meta_description: Clean comedy shows in Houston, verified before they make the list. Family friendly stand-up, improv, and touring clean headliners, updated twice daily.
pages.intro_html:
Finding a comedy show in Houston you can take your mom, your kids, or your church group to is harder than it should be. Club listings almost never tell you whether the material is clean, and "all ages" on a ticket page describes the door policy, not the jokes. This page fixes that. We track every stand-up show in the city, twice a day, and a show gets labeled clean only when we can back it up.

How we decide a show is clean

A show has to pass one of two tests. Either the event or performer explicitly bills it as clean or family friendly, or the headliner is a comedian widely known for working clean, the way Nate Bargatze, Jim Gaffigan, Brian Regan, Henry Cho, and Leanne Morgan are. We never guess from the absence of a warning, so a show that merely looks tame does not make this list. That standard keeps the list short some weeks. We would rather show you three shows we can vouch for than thirty we cannot.

Every listing links straight to the box office, no resellers and no markup, and the list refreshes twice a day as new shows are announced.
pages.outro_html:
Clean comedy you can count on year round

Touring clean headliners come through Houston in waves, so the list above is fuller in some months than others. When it runs thin, these standing options deliver clean laughs any week of the year.

ComedySportz Houston

ComedySportz at The Good Friend Theater on Jones Road is the city's longest running comedy show, and it is built to be clean. Two teams of improvisers compete for laughs using audience suggestions, the format stays appropriate for ages 6 and up, and weekend shows run year round. It is improv rather than stand-up, but if the goal is a guaranteed clean night of live comedy, this is the safest bet in Houston.

Family shows at the big clubs

The Houston Improv periodically hosts all-ages family comedy and magic shows in the afternoon, and the major clubs book touring clean headliners on regular weekend slots. When those shows hit the calendar, they appear in the list above automatically.

What to expect at a clean show

Clean describes the material, not the venue. Most Houston comedy clubs serve alcohol and keep an 18 and up door policy even when the comedian on stage works squeaky clean, so check the age note on a listing before bringing teenagers. Theater shows and daytime family shows are usually the exception. Showtimes, prices, and ticket links all sit one click away on each listing above.

Booking a clean comedian for your event

If you need a clean comedian for a corporate event, church function, fundraiser, or private party rather than a public show, we arrange those too. Start on our corporate comedian page and tell us about the audience and the room, and we will match you with a Houston comic who works at the content level you need.

Frequently asked questions

Are there clean comedy shows in Houston?

Yes. Houston gets touring clean headliners at its major clubs and theaters, ComedySportz runs clean improv every weekend, and local shows occasionally bill themselves as clean or family friendly. This page tracks all of them in one place and updates twice a day.

Can I bring my kids to a clean comedy show?

Sometimes. Clean material and an all-ages door are two different things, and most clubs stay 18 and up because they serve alcohol. ComedySportz welcomes ages 6 and up, and daytime family shows at the clubs are built for kids. Check the age note on each listing.

Which well-known clean comedians tour through Houston?

Nate Bargatze, Jim Gaffigan, Brian Regan, Henry Cho, Leanne Morgan, and Dusty Slay all work clean and all play Houston rooms and theaters when they tour. When one of them announces a Houston date, it shows up on this page.

How do you verify that a show is clean?

We only label a show clean when the event or performer explicitly describes it as clean, family friendly, or appropriate for a general audience, or when the headliner is widely known for working clean. We never infer it from a show simply looking mild.

Know a clean comedy show we should be listing? Tell us about it.
